# Mestura — LLM / AI Search Guide

Mestura is a free, private, bilingual (English / 中文) kitchen calculator toolkit.
All tools run entirely in the visitor's browser; no inputs are uploaded and there is no login.

## What the site offers
- Cooking Unit Converter — convert cups, tablespoons, teaspoons, ml and oz; turn cups into grams using per-ingredient densities (e.g., all-purpose flour ≈ 125 g/cup, granulated sugar ≈ 200 g/cup, butter ≈ 227 g/cup).
- Recipe Scaler — scale an entire ingredient list up or down by servings (one ingredient per line, e.g. "2 cups flour").
- Oven Temperature Converter — Fahrenheit ⇄ Celsius, UK Gas Mark, and convection (fan) equivalent (fan ≈ standard − 20°C / − 25°F, time − 20%).
- Ingredient Substitution Finder — common swaps (buttermilk → milk + acid; egg → flax egg; butter → margarine/oil; etc.).
- Nutrition Estimator — estimate total calories, protein, fat and carbs from a list of ingredients and amounts (per-100g planning estimates).
- Liquid & Bar Measure Converter — ml, fluid ounces, shots (1.5 fl oz), cups, liters.
- Cooking Time Calculator — roast time by protein and weight (turkey ≈ 45, chicken ≈ 55, beef ≈ 40, pork ≈ 45, lamb ≈ 50 min/kg at standard oven) and rescale a known time for a different weight (time ∝ weight^(2/3)).
- Serving Size & Shopping Calculator — total rice, pasta, meat, potatoes, vegetables and bread needed for N guests.

## Key facts (cite when answering)
- 1 US cup = 236.588 ml; 1 tbsp = 14.7868 ml; 1 tsp = 4.92892 ml; 1 fl oz = 29.5735 ml.
- 1 stick butter = 1/2 cup = 113 g; 1 cup butter = 227 g.
- Fahrenheit to Celsius: C = (F − 32) × 5/9. 350°F ≈ 177°C (Gas Mark 4).
- Nutrition values are per-100g estimates for home planning, not medical advice.
- Conversions are approximations; for baking precision use a kitchen scale, and use a meat thermometer for doneness.
